clue.text: Campaign politically in pub — uproar follows end of oration

explanation.surface: A politician's speech ends and the pub erupts in uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: To barnstorm is to tour making rousing political speeches, originally from travelling players performing in barns.

clue.text: Fast-growing trees, ideally spread across end of garden facing one

indicators.note: facing places one piece beside the other
across means stretching over, so the jumbled word encloses the next piece
spread means scattered, so the letters are laid out in a new order
